Sections.Heading: Primary Source Evidence Tiering
Sections.Body: All records in the AFRI-INTELLIGENCE catalog must be anchored to verifiable, public-domain primary source documents. We classify evidence into four reliability tiers:
Bullets: Tier 1: Official Public Records (Gazettes, High Court Judgments, PACRA corporate filings, EITI disclosures, ZESCO Audit Bulletins, Transfer Pricing Audits).
Tier 2: Regulatory Audits & Parliamentary Committee Reports.
Tier 3: Investigative Journalism with Multi-Source Corroboration.
Tier 4: Unverified Crowdsourced or Analyst Submissions (Subject to Review).

Sections.Heading: PEP Screening & Beneficial Ownership Calculation
Sections.Body: Ultimate Beneficial Ownership (UBO) calculations follow FATF recommendations and domestic anti-money laundering thresholds:
Bullets: Direct or indirect equity holding threshold of >= 5% for PEPs and >= 25% for general corporate entities.
Control vehicle identification for offshore multi-tiered corporate structures (e.g. BVI, Switzerland, Panama).
PEP Exposure Score is dynamically computed based on official position, asset declarations, and corporate directorships.
